import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from kh import *
D=load(); d5=np.load('my5_feats_clean.npz')
Zp,yp=D['Zp'],D['yp']
Zmine=np.concatenate([D['Zm'],D['Z3'],D['Z4'],d5['Z']]); ymine=np.concatenate([D['ym'],D['y3'],D['y4'],d5['y']])
print(len(Zmine))
NC=1576
def pivchol_select(Zc_fixed, Zcand, k):
    # greedy select candidates maximizing residual variance given fixed centers (kernel feature space, approx with gelu kernel)
    allZ=np.concatenate([Zc_fixed,Zcand]); K=gelu(allZ@allZ.T/768)
    nF=len(Zc_fixed); n=len(allZ)
    # Cholesky residual diag after conditioning on fixed set
    Kff=K[:nF,:nF]+1e-6*np.eye(nF); Kfc=K[:nF,nF:]
    Lf=np.linalg.cholesky(Kff); V=np.linalg.solve(Lf,Kfc)  # nF x m
    Kcc=K[nF:,nF:]-V.T@V
    d=np.diag(Kcc).copy(); m=len(Zcand); sel=[]; G=np.zeros((k,m))
    for j in range(k):
        i=int(np.argmax(d)); sel.append(i)
        g=(Kcc[i]-G[:j,i]@G[:j])/np.sqrt(max(d[i],1e-12)); G[j]=g; d=d-g**2; d[sel]=-np.inf
    return np.array(sel)
def cv_sel(mode, wx=0.4, lam=0.007, seeds=(0,1,2), nf=5):
    accs=[]
    for s in seeds:
        fo=folds(yp,s,nf); pred=np.zeros(1496,int)
        for f in range(nf):
            tr=fo!=f
            if mode=='random': sel=np.random.default_rng(100+s).permutation(len(Zmine))[:NC]
            elif mode=='piv': sel=pivchol_select(Zp[tr],Zmine,NC)
            elif mode=='all': sel=np.arange(len(Zmine))
            Cc=np.concatenate([Zp[tr],Zmine[sel]])
            Zt=np.concatenate([Zp[tr],Zmine]); yt=np.concatenate([yp[tr],ymine]); wt=np.concatenate([np.ones(tr.sum()),np.full(len(Zmine),wx)])
            a,b=fit(gelu(Zt@Cc.T/768),yt,wt,lam)
            pred[~tr]=np.argmax(gelu(Zp[~tr]@Cc.T/768)@a+b,1)
        accs.append((pred==yp).mean())
    return round(np.mean(accs),4), np.round(accs,4)
import time; t=time.time()
print('random', cv_sel('random'), time.time()-t)
print('piv', cv_sel('piv'), time.time()-t)
